_comment: WHAT IT IS: the settings block that registers block-sensitive-edits.sh as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook.

HOW TO USE: merge the "hooks" key into .claude/settings.json (shared with the team through the repo) or ~/.claude/settings.json (all your projects). If the file already has a "hooks" key, add this entry to its "PreToolUse" array. Do not copy this "_comment" key: JSON has no comments, so the notes live here.

WHAT TO CHANGE: (1) the command path, if the script is not at .claude/hooks/ in the project; for a user-level hook point it at a path in your home folder such as ~/.claude/hooks/block-sensitive-edits.sh. (2) the matcher, if you want to guard more or fewer tools; it lists exact tool names separated by |. (3) the timeout, in seconds.
CHECK: run /hooks in a session to see that the hook is loaded, then ask the agent to edit .env and confirm it is refused.

VERIFIED AGAINST: the official hooks reference and hooks guide (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks and /hooks-guide) as published on 2026-11-24, Claude Code 2.1.x. The shape is version-sensitive: re-check after an upgrade.
